config.purpose: 16-player role-separated ballot reasoning, inspection-only history use, cover coordination, nomination-origin and split-vote mafia counters
config.selection: Pure train-only response chain and maximin row with lexicographic name tie break; no heldout selection.
config.interpretation: All local strategies use legal observations. Origin and ballot scores are fixed proxies, not beliefs. Main and sensitivity boards are 4 police, 4 mafia, 8 civilians. No full-game GTO claim.

intervals: Pointwise Wilson and paired normal/Hoeffding; familywise 95% Hoeffding applies only to prespecified test contrasts.
outcome: good faction terminal win, 0/1; no rollout truncation
